cards.ex: Financial insecurity is a major stressor for many families.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy beqarorlik ko'p oilalar uchun asosiy stress omili hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Stressga sabab bo'luvchi narsa, hodisa yoki shaxs.

cards.ex: I'm trying to plan a stress-free vacation this year.
cards.exUz: Men bu yil stresssiz ta'til rejalashtirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Stress yo'q bo'lgan yoki stressdan xoli bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: He was plagued by anxiety after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin u doimiy xavotirda edi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda xavotir va tashvishga duchor bo'lgan.

cards.ex: You could feel the strain on the healthcare system during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya davrida sog'liqni saqlash tizimidagi zo'riqishni his qilish mumkin edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik, bosim yoki stress natijasida charchoqni sezish.

cards.ex: She completely came undone when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U xabarni eshitgach, butunlay o'zini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarini boshqara olmay, yig'lab yubormoq yoki ruhiy tushkunlikka tushmoq.

cards.ex: I'm stressed to the max with these deadlines looming.
cards.exUz: Men bu muddatlar yaqinlashgani sababli maksimal darajada stressdaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda yuqori darajada stressga tushgan, haddan tashqari xavotirda.

cards.ex: The caffeine put him in a heightened state of awareness.
cards.exUz: Kofein uni ogohlikning kuchaygan holatiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlar kuchaygan, sezgirlik oshgan holat.

cards.ex: I'm experiencing mental fatigue after weeks of intense study.
cards.exUz: Men bir necha haftalik qizg'in o'qishdan so'ng ruhiy charchoqni his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy zo'riqish natijasida kelib chiqqan charchoq hissi.

cards.ex: His stress response involved increased heart rate and sweating.
cards.exUz: Uning stress reaksiyasi yurak urishi tezlashishi va terlashni o'z ichiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Organizmning stressga bo'lgan fiziologik va psixologik javobi.

cards.ex: Her anxiety tends to flare up before big presentations.
cards.exUz: Uning xavotiri katta taqdimotlardan oldin kuchayib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik, muammo yoki his-tuyg'uning birdan kuchayishi.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Biz imtihon natijalarini kutib, xavotirda edik.
cards.uzDef: Natijani kutib, kuchli xavotirda yoki hayajonda bo'lish.

cards.ex: His health has been a constant worry for his family.
cards.exUz: Uning sog'lig'i oilasi uchun doimiy tashvish bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda o'ylantiradigan tashvish yoki muammo.

cards.ex: Stress inoculation training can help people manage anxiety.
cards.exUz: Stressga qarshi emlash treningi odamlarga xavotirni boshqarishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Stressni boshqarish uchun psixologik tayyorgarlik.

cards.ex: Moving to a new city can be a stressful situation.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chish stressli vaziyat bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Stressga sabab bo'luvchi yoki xavotir uyg'otuvchi holat.

cards.ex: Don't drive yourself crazy trying to solve every problem at once.
cards.exUz: Hamma muammolarni birdaniga hal qilishga urinib, o'zingizni aqldan ozdirmang.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari o'ylash, xavotirlanish yoki g'azablanish orqali o'ziga zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: Her stress tolerance has increased with years of experience.
cards.exUz: Uning stressga chidamliligi ko'p yillik tajriba bilan oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Stressga bardosh berish va unga yaxshi moslashish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: His stress level was noticeably higher than usual.
cards.exUz: Uning stress darajasi odatdagidan sezilarli darajada yuqori edi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning stress holati yoki miqdori.

cards.ex: Deadlines are often stress-inducing for employees.
cards.exUz: Muddatlar ko'pincha xodimlar uchun stress keltiruvchi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Stressga sabab bo'luvchi yoki xavotir uyg'otuvchi narsa.

cards.ex: The worries about her family were weighing her down.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi haqidagi tashvishlar uni bosib tushayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Tashvishlar tufayli o'zini og'ir, tushkun va xafa his qilish.

cards.ex: The stressful workload left her feeling exhausted and depleted.
cards.exUz: Stressli ish yuklamasi uni charchagan va holdan toygan his qildirardi.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish kerak bo'lgan ko'p sonli vazifalar yoki topshiriqlar stressga olib keladi.

cards.ex: I started to feel overwhelmed by the amount of information I had to learn.
cards.exUz: Men o'rganishim kerak bo'lgan ma'lumotlar miqdori meni bosim ostida qoldira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolar yoki vazifalar ko'pligi tufayli o'zini ojiz va nazoratdan tashqari his qilish.

cards.ex: He snapped under the pressure of the job and resigned.
cards.exUz: U ishning bosimiga bardosh bera olmay, iste'foga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari bosimga dosh bera olmasdan ruhiy tushkunlikka tushmoq.

cards.ex: Biting her lip is a nervous habit she developed as a child.
cards.exUz: Labini tishlash - uning bolaligida rivojlangan asabiy odati.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki xavotirda bo'lganda takrorlanadigan harakat.

cards.ex: Yoga and meditation are effective methods for stress reduction.
cards.exUz: Yoga va meditatsiya stressni kamaytirishning samarali usullari hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Stress darajasini pasaytirishga qaratilgan harakatlar.

cards.ex: The days leading up to the surgery were wrought with anxiety.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan oldingi kunlar xavotirga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta xavotir yoki tashvish bilan to'lgan.

cards.ex: Crowded places can be a trigger for her anxiety.
cards.exUz: Odamlar gavjum joylar uning xavotirini qo'zg'atishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir hissini keltirib chiqaradigan narsa, vaziyat yoki fikr.

cards.ex: Life is full of stressful events, but it's how you react that matters.
cards.exUz: Hayot stressli voqealarga to'la, lekin sizning reaksiyangiz muhim.
cards.uzDef: Stressga sabab bo'luvchi yoki xavotir uyg'otuvchi hodisalar.

cards.ex: Exercise helps me keep my worries at bay.
cards.exUz: Jismoniy mashqlar menga tashvishlarimni uzoqroq tutishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Tashvishlarni oldini olish, ularni boshqarmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After the marathon, I felt completely strung out.
cards.exUz: Marafon tugagandan so'ng, men butunlay holdan toyganimni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida stress, charchoq yoki giyohvand moddalar ta'sirida holdan toygan his qilish.

cards.ex: Stress inoculation therapy can teach you to react differently to stress.
cards.exUz: Stressga qarshi emlash terapiyasi sizga stressga boshqacha munosabatda bo'lishni o'rgatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Stressni boshqarish uchun psixologik tayyorgarlik terapiyasi.
